"""W2-96 review, read-only: what gov accept's reader takes from W1-46's and W1-27's README maps before and after
48c2cd33b, and why each line that fails with no failed case fails (D-4's deselection, or an item form no case
can match). Uses the runner's own functions; runs pytest only with --collect-only (no case executes)."""
import os
import subprocess
import sys
from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

TREE = Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
sys.path.insert(0, str(TREE / "src"))
from gov.accept import runner as R  # noqa: E402

REV = "48c2cd33b"
FOLDERS = ("tests/acceptance/W1-46", "tests/acceptance/W1-27")
SUBS = {
    "tests/acceptance/W1-46": [
        ("| Success 1 [CAP-61.a], failures 1, 2, 8 |", "| Success 1, failure 1, failure 2, failure 8 [CAP-61.a] |"),
        ("| Success 4 [CAP-61.c], failures 4, 5 |", "| Success 4, failure 4, failure 5 [CAP-61.c] |"),
        ("| Success 6 [CAP-25.e], failures 6, 7 |", "| Success 6, failure 6, failure 7 [CAP-25.e] |"),
        ("| Success 9 [CAP-49.b], failure 9 |", "| Success 9, failure 9 [CAP-49.b] |"),
        ("| DEC-242 (no KPI line of its own; refusals in the words of success 1) |",
         "| Success 1 (DEC-242: no KPI line of its own; refusals in the words of success 1) |"),
    ],
    "tests/acceptance/W1-27": [("### Success KPI ", "### Success "), ("### Failure KPI ", "### Failure ")],
}


def git_show(spec):
    return subprocess.run(["git", "-C", str(TREE), "show", spec], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True).stdout


def tolerant(text, case_column=False):
    """parse_map's own walk; a row it would refuse is listed instead of raising. case_column: also take a column
    titled 'case(s)...' as the test column (to read the D-4 tables, which the reader skips)."""
    mapping, refused = {}, []
    heading, naming, fenced, table = [], False, False, None
    starts = ("test", "file", "case") if case_column else ("test", "file")
    for number, raw in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1):
        line = raw.strip()
        if line.startswith(("```", "~~~")):
            fenced, table = not fenced, None
            continue
        if fenced:
            continue
        if not line.startswith("|"):
            table = None
            if line.startswith("#"):
                title = line.lstrip("#").replace("*", "").strip()
                heading, naming = R.line_names(title), bool(R.NAMING.match(title))
            continue
        cells = R._cells(line)
        if table is None:
            titles = [c.lower() for c in cells]
            kpi = next((i for i, t in enumerate(titles) if t.startswith("kpi")), None)
            test = next((i for i, t in enumerate(titles) if t.startswith(starts)), None)
            table = False if test is None else (kpi, test, heading)
            continue
        if not table or all(R.SEPARATOR.fullmatch(c) for c in cells):
            continue
        kpi, test, names = table
        if kpi is not None:
            names = R.line_names(cells[kpi]) if kpi < len(cells) else []
        items = R.ITEM.findall(cells[test]) if test < len(cells) else []
        if items and not names and (kpi is not None or naming):
            refused.append(number)
            continue
        for name in names if items else []:
            mapping.setdefault(name, []).extend(items)
    return mapping, refused


def d4_section(text):
    """Only the 'KPI map after D-4's cut' section, read with its 'case(s)' column as the test column."""
    lines, keep = [], False
    for raw in text.splitlines():
        if raw.startswith("## "):
            keep = raw.startswith("## KPI map after D-4")
        if keep:
            lines.append(raw)
    return tolerant("\n".join(lines), case_column=True)[0]


def collect(folder, optin):
    env = {k: v for k, v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(("PYTEST_", "PYTHON")) and k != "GOV_TESTS_OPTIN"}
    env.update(PYTHONPATH=str(TREE / "src"), PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE="1")
    if os.environ.get("PYTHONUSERBASE"):
        env["PYTHONUSERBASE"] = os.environ["PYTHONUSERBASE"]
    cmd = [sys.executable, "-B", "-m", "pytest", str(TREE / folder), f"--rootdir={TREE}", "-p", "no:cacheprovider",
           "-o", "tmp_path_retention_policy=failed", "--collect-only", "-q"]
    if optin:
        cmd.append(f"--optin={optin}")
    done = subprocess.run(cmd, cwd=TREE, env=env, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=900)
    ids = [l.strip() for l in done.stdout.splitlines() if "::" in l and not l.startswith((" ", "="))]
    tail = [l for l in done.stdout.splitlines() if "collected" in l or "deselected" in l][-1:]
    if done.returncode not in (0,):
        print(f"   collect {folder} optin={optin!r}: exit {done.returncode}; stderr tail: {done.stderr[-600:]}")
    return [R.Case(i.partition("::")[0], i.partition("::")[2].split("::")[-1], "passed") for i in ids], tail


def verdicts(title, mapping, default, breadth, everything):
    result, _ = R._report("x", mapping, default)  # every collected case taken as passed (the helper: 0 failed)
    print(f"\n== {title}: outcome {result['outcome']}; unmapped {result['unmapped']['passed']}")
    for line in result["lines"]:
        name, items = line["kpi"], mapping[line["kpi"]]
        hit = [c for c in default if any(R.matches(i, c) for i in items)]
        files = Counter(Path(c.file).name for c in hit)
        missing = [i for i in items if R.names_a_test(i) and not any(R.matches(i, c) for c in default)]
        print(f"{name}: {line['outcome']} (matched {len(hit)} in {dict(files)}; missing {len(missing)})")
        for i in missing:
            if any(R.matches(i, c) for c in breadth):
                where = "collected only with --optin=breadth"
            elif any(R.matches(i, c) for c in everything):
                where = "collected only with --optin=lifted"
            else:
                rows = [run for run, cases in (("default", default), ("breadth", breadth), ("all", everything))
                        if any(c.name == i for c in cases)]
                where = f"matches no case in any run; a case named exactly so is in: {rows or 'none'}"
            print(f"   missing {i}: {where}")
    return result


def main():
    for folder in FOLDERS:
        readme = f"{folder}/README.md"
        before, at_rev, head = git_show(f"{REV}^:{readme}"), git_show(f"{REV}:{readme}"), (TREE / readme).read_text()
        print(f"\n######## {folder}")
        print("HEAD's README equals the revision's:", head == at_rev)
        substituted = before
        for old, new in SUBS[folder]:
            print(f"   substitution occurs {before.count(old)} time(s): {old[:60]!r}")
            substituted = substituted.replace(old, new)
        print("before + the stated substitutions == after:", substituted == at_rev)
        try:
            R.parse_map(before)
            print("parse_map before: readable")
        except R.Unreadable:
            print("parse_map before: Unreadable")
        official = R.parse_map(at_rev)
        m_old, refused_old = tolerant(before)
        m_new, refused_new = tolerant(at_rev)
        print("parse_map after == tolerant after:", official == m_new, "; rows refused before:", refused_old,
              "; after:", refused_new)
        for name in R.ordered({**m_old, **m_new}):
            a, b = m_old.get(name, []), m_new.get(name, [])
            if a != b:
                added = [i for i in b if i not in a]
                print(f"   {name}: items before {len(a)}, after {len(b)}; added (first 4) {added[:4]}; "
                      f"removed {[i for i in a if i not in b]}")
        default, t1 = collect(folder, "")
        breadth, t2 = collect(folder, "breadth")
        everything, t3 = collect(folder, "breadth,lifted")
        print("collections:", t1, t2, t3)
        verdicts(f"{folder} as gov accept reads it (after)", official, default, breadth, everything)
        d4 = d4_section(at_rev)
        verdicts(f"{folder}: the D-4 table, if the reader took it", d4, default, breadth, everything)
        if folder.endswith("W1-46"):
            for name in ("success-6", "failure-6"):
                hit = sorted({c.name.split("[")[0] for c in default if any(R.matches(i, c) for i in official[name])
                              and "research_installs" in c.file})
                print(f"   {name}: matched cases of test_w1_46_research_installs.py in the default run: {hit}")


main()
